template.name: aide-review
template.value:
Do a thorough code review of my changes before the PR.
STEP 1: GET THE DIFF Run: git diff main...HEAD
STEP 2: ANALYZE THE CHANGES For each changed file, assess: - Correctness (logic errors, edge cases, null handling) - Security (injection, hardcoded secrets) - Performance (unnecessary re-renders, N+1 queries) - Code quality (DRY, complexity, typing) - Testing (missing tests)
STEP 3: CATEGORIZE FINDINGS - CRITICAL - Must be fixed (security, crashes, data loss) - IMPORTANT - Should be fixed (bugs, performance) - SUGGESTION - Could be improved (code quality) - NITPICK - Minor things (formatting)
STEP 4: PRESENT THE RESULT Show a summary with file:line references.

template.name: aide-create
template.value:
Create documentation for JIRA issue $ISSUE_ID$:
STEP 1: CREATE THE DIRECTORY STRUCTURE Create: reports/<NN>-$ISSUE_ID$-slug/
STEP 2: CREATE THE 4-FILE STRUCTURE Follow core/rules/documentation.md: - 1-description.md (JIRA data, acceptance criteria) - 2-analysis.md (empty, filled in during the analysis phase) - 3-solution.md (empty, filled in during the solution phase) - 4-status.md (progress tracking)
STEP 3: STAGE FILES Run: git add reports/<NN>-$ISSUE_ID$-slug/

template.name: aide-analyze
template.value:
Analyze the codebase for $ISSUE_ID$:
STEP 1: READ THE DESCRIPTION Read: reports/<NN>-$ISSUE_ID$-slug/1-description.md
STEP 2: IDENTIFY AFFECTED FILES Search the codebase for related code.
STEP 3: ASSESS COMPLEXITY - LOW: 1-2 files, < 2 hours - MEDIUM: 3-5 files, 2-8 hours - HIGH: > 5 files, > 8 hours
STEP 4: UPDATE 2-ANALYSIS.MD Write findings with file:line references.
STEP 5: CREATE AN IMPLEMENTATION PLAN Write a TDD-based plan to 3-solution.md.
Reference: core/rules/workflows.md

template.name: aide-implement
template.value:
Implement the solution for $ISSUE_ID$ with TDD:
STEP 1: READ THE IMPLEMENTATION PLAN Read: reports/<NN>-$ISSUE_ID$-slug/3-solution.md
STEP 2: RED PHASE - WRITE TESTS Write tests that fail (defining the expected behavior). Run: pnpm test -- --run <testfile> Verify that the tests FAIL.
STEP 3: GREEN PHASE - IMPLEMENT Implement the minimum needed to make the tests pass. Run tests after each step.
STEP 4: REFACTOR PHASE - QUALITY ASSURANCE Run: npx tsc --noEmit Run: pnpm run eslint Run: pnpm test -- --run
STEP 5: UPDATE STATUS Update: reports/<NN>-$ISSUE_ID$-slug/4-status.md
Reference: core/rules/testing.md

template.name: aide-make-tests
template.value:
Analyze the file $FILE_PATH$ and create missing unit tests:
STEP 1: ANALYZE THE FILE Read the file and identify all exported functions. Check the existing test file. Identify gaps in the test coverage.
STEP 2: WRITE TESTS For each function missing tests: - Happy path (normal scenarios) - Edge cases (boundary conditions) - Error cases (error handling)
STEP 3: RUN AND VERIFY Run: pnpm test -- --run <testfile> Verify that all tests pass.
STEP 4: COVERAGE Run: pnpm test -- --coverage Show before/after test coverage.

template.name: aide-react-class-to-func
template.value:
Convert React class component to functional component:
FILE: $FILE_PATH$
STEP 1: ANALYZE THE COMPONENT Read the file and identify: - State (this.state → useState) - Lifecycle methods (componentDidMount → useEffect) - Event handlers - Refs (createRef → useRef)
STEP 2: CONVERT - Replace class with function - Convert state to useState hooks - Convert lifecycle to useEffect - Keep the same props interface
STEP 3: VERIFY Run: npx tsc --noEmit Run the existing tests.
